name: tillbooks
description: TILL (Trusted Independent Ledger Library) is a free, open-source (MIT), local-first Swiss accounting app where an AI agent posts entries, categorizes, drafts and chases invoices, and prepares the MWST-Abrechnung through a first-class MCP interface, with a minimalist Studio for human oversight.
author: Nomadik GmbH

scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:studio
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:src && npm run typecheck:test
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run check:style && npm test
scripts.gate: npm run check && npm run gate:studio
scripts.gate:studio: cd app && npm run build && npx vitest run
scripts.seed:demo: npm run build && TILL_DB_PATH=$HOME/.till/till-demo.db node scripts/seed-demo-rich.mjs
scripts.seed:demo:reset: npm run build && TILL_DB_PATH=$HOME/.till/till-demo.db node scripts/seed-demo-rich.mjs --reset
scripts.seed:kaizen: npm run build && TILL_DB_PATH=$HOME/.till/till-kaizen-golden.db TILL_SEED_TODAY=$(date +%F) node scripts/seed-demo-rich.mjs --reset
scripts.seed:kaizen:restore: sh -c 'rm -f "$HOME/.till/till-kaizen.db" "$HOME/.till/till-kaizen.db-wal" "$HOME/.till/till-kaizen.db-shm" && cp "$HOME/.till/till-kaizen-golden.db" "$HOME/.till/till-kaizen.db" && for s in -wal -shm; do if [ -f "$HOME/.till/till-kaizen-golden.db$s" ]; then cp "$HOME/.till/till-kaizen-golden.db$s" "$HOME/.till/till-kaizen.db$s"; fi; done'
